h1: Custom Folding Magnets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom folding magnets in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for promotions, giveaways, and business branding with a unique fold-out design.
introHtml: Custom folding magnets offer a compact promotional item that unfolds to reveal a larger message area, making them ideal for trade shows, real estate open houses, or business card alternatives. The folding design provides twice the space for your logo and contact details while remaining small enough to fit in a pocket or attach to a file cabinet. Choose from various paper stocks and finishes to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom folding magnets with business logo and contact details, displayed open and closed on a metal surface.
